newsitem.title: USA: UAL sees Q1 EPS above $1.30.
newsitem.headline: UAL sees Q1 EPS above $1.30.

text.p: UAL Corp said Tuesday it expects its first quater earnings to exceed the highest analyst estimate on First Call of $1.30 per fully distributed share.
Earlier, UAL's United Airlines reported a rise in February passenger load factor to 68.4 percent from 66.3 percent a year earlier.
United said February traffic, combined with January results, have led it to re-evaluate its outlook for the first quarter.
According to First Call, the range of first quarter estimates is $0.95 to $1.30 a share, with a mean of $1.08.
In the year-ago first quarter UAL earned $0.77 a share, according to First Call.
